title: Inconsistent markdown rendering
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.25.3 ### Bug Description Text is being rendered inconsistently. Expect regular or bold text, receive h2. The following text was used: ```markdown Top --- **Bolded** words --- **more, same bolded** regular text ``` ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Create new note. 2. Enter text from description. 3. Save note. ### Expected Behavior Expected to be rendered in standard markdown format without any headings present. ### Screenshots & Additional Context Actual output is as follows: ```html

Top

Bolded words

more, same bolded regular text

``` but no headings should be present.
why_ui_reproducible: Create a memo whose text has a line followed by a "---" line; the saved memo renders those lines as headings in the memo list.
notes:
Verified with Playwright: memo "Top
--- 
**Bolded** words
---
**more, same bolded** regular text" created via API, home page inspected. 0.25.3 renders h2 "Top" and h2 "Bolded words"; 0.26.0 renders no headings. Fix commit "disable setext header syntax" touches only web/ (MemoContent + new remark plugin). Duplicate report #5609 (v0.25.3, closed not planned) has the same cause. Note the first "---" in the issue text has a trailing space.

title: Markdown List Auto-Completion Adds Symbol to Current Line Instead of New Line
body: ### Describe the bug When using the Markdown editor in the content management system, the auto-completion feature for unordered lists is behaving incorrectly. When entering `- 123` or `* 123` and pressing Enter, the system appends an extra `-` or `*` to the end of the current line instead of inserting it on a new line. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the Markdown editor in the content publishing interface. 2. Type `- 123` (or `* 123`) in the editor. 3. Press the Enter key to create a new line. ## Expected Behavior - The current line should remain as `- 123` (or `* 123`). - A new line should be automatically prepended with `-` (or `*`) to continue the unordered list. ## Actual Behavior - The current line becomes `- 123-` (or `* 123*`) after pressing Enter. - The line break is not properly applied, and the list symbol is incorrectly appended to the existing line. ### The version of Memos you're using 0.25.2 ### Screenshots or additional context
why_ui_reproducible: Editor on the home page: type "- 123", press Enter, keep typing; the list marker lands in the wrong place.
notes: Fix is PR #5238 (web/src/components/MemoEditor/Editor/index.tsx only). Verified: typing "- 123", Enter, "456" gives "- 123\n4- 56" on 0.25.2 (after Enter the new line is empty, marker is inserted after the first typed char) and "- 123\n- 456" on 0.25.3. The manifestation differs from the reporter text ("- 123-" on the same line), so an agent needs to judge that the marker is not placed at the start of the new line.

title: Filtering with tags no longer shows sub-tagged Memos
body:
### Describe the bug

Say I have 2 tags, "#House" and "#House/Garden". Previously, filtering by "#House" would show Memos that were tagged "#House" AND "#House/Garden". Now, it's completely explicit, so only the selected tag shows up and no sub-tags are included.

This feature was useful for drilling down in specificity of Memos, especially once your server gets into the hundreds of Memos, I'd quite like to see it come back if this was an intentional change.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a Memo with "#Tag/Subtag"
- Filter the Memos by "#Tag"
- Memos with "#Tag/Subtag" do not appear in the results

### The version of Memos you're using


v0.25.1

### Screenshots or additional context

_No response_
why_ui_reproducible: Create memos tagged #house and #house/garden, click the "house" tag in the left sidebar, see which memos are listed.
notes: Verified: memos "#house", "#house/garden", "#other"; click sidebar tag "house" (URL ?filter=tagSearch:house). 0.25.2 lists only the #house memo; 0.25.3 lists #house and #house/garden. Issue was filed against v0.25.1 and closed on 2025-10-10 without a linked commit; the fix commit "feat(store): add hierarchical tag filtering support" (plugin/filter/render.go, backend) is inferred from the observed 0.25.2 to 0.25.3 change and git tag --contains, not from an issue link.

title: Selecting a layout doesn't update the selection or layout until the page is refreshed
body: ### Describe the bug When I try to change the layout (i.e., from List to Masonry), neither the selection nor the layout are updated until I refresh the screen. That is, it appears my selection was ineffective. But if I refresh the screen, the layout I selected takes effect and is indicated correctly in the layout selector. ### Steps to reproduce Select a layout other than the current one. ### The version of Memos you're using v0.25.2 ### Screenshots or additional context
why_ui_reproducible: Home page: open the display-settings menu next to the search box, pick Masonry as layout; the dropdown still shows List until reload.
notes: Fix is web/src/store/view.ts only (MobX observable). Verified: after choosing "Masonry" the combobox shows "List" on 0.25.2 and "Masonry" on 0.25.3; after reload both show Masonry. The visual masonry layout change was not measured, only the selector state. Duplicate #5230 (same bug, 0.25.2). The menu is the icon at the right end of the search box.

Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26.0 ### Bug Description ``` Update user: [invalid_argument] rpc error: code = InvalidArgument desc = invalid user name: invalid request "" ``` ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Go to 2. Create a member. 3. Edit the new user, change username or password, save. 4. You will got the error message. ### Expected Behavior _No response_ ### Screenshots & Additional Context
why_ui_reproducible: Settings > Member: open the row menu of a member, choose Update, enter a new password, press Confirm; an error is shown and nothing is saved.
notes: Fix is web/src/components/CreateUserDialog.tsx only (request name). Verified: member "bob" created via API, password changed in the Edit User dialog and Confirm pressed. 0.26.0: dialog stays open and bob cannot sign in with the new password; 0.26.1: dialog closes and bob can sign in with the new password. The toast text was not captured by the script. Related, still-open-looking reports #5596 (password) were not used.

title: Can't use spaces when searching to reference a memo
body:
### Describe the bug

You can't use spaces when searching for a Memo to link in the Memo editor. I've got about 200 Memos, and this makes it difficult to reference a Memo that was posted a while ago.

We should either be able to use spaces when searching for a Memo to reference, making it easier to narrow the list down, or there should be a button in the memo hamburger menu to reference the selected memo in a new one.

It's currently difficult to reference older memos.

### Steps to reproduce

- Click link icon in Memo editor
- Try to type using spaces
- Spaces are not included, making it difficult to search for memos to link

### The version of Memos you're using


v0.24.3

### Screenshots or additional context

_No response_
why_ui_reproducible: Memo editor: click the link icon, type a phrase with a space in "Search content"; the space is swallowed.
notes: Fix is web/ only (AddMemoRelationPopover.tsx trim to trimStart, plus SearchBar trim in df8d1d4f3), first shipped in 0.25.0. Issue filed on 0.24.3; verified on 0.24.4 (typing "Grocery shopping" gives "Groceryshopping") vs 0.25.0 ("Grocery shopping"). 0.24.4 to 0.25.0 has a large visual redesign, so screenshots differ a lot. The dropdown options were not asserted, only the input text.

title: Todo command doesn't work in some desktop browsers
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.25.3

### Bug Description

When i use `/todo` command it doesn't work in most **desktop** browsers.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. In Google Сhrome browser open a note in edit mode
2. Press `/` in the very beginning of an empty line
3. Press enter while `/todo` is highlighted

### Expected

`- [ ] ` to appear

### Actual

The line remains empty

### Additional Context

**Client envs**:
- Desktop Google Chrome browser
- Desktop Firefox browser
- Desktop Brave browser

**Notes**:
1. The feature works when the line is not empty.
2. The feature works as expected in Android Chrome browser
why_ui_reproducible: Memo editor on desktop: type "/" on an empty line, press Enter on "/todo"; the line stays empty instead of "- [ ] ".
notes: Fix is PR #5329 (web/src/components/MemoEditor/Editor/useSuggestions.ts only). Verified: typing "/todo" + Enter on an empty editor gives "" on 0.25.3 and "- [ ] " on 0.26.0. Clicking the suggestion with the mouse works on both, so an agent that clicks instead of pressing Enter will not see the bug. Duplicate #5459 (also 0.25.3, closed not planned).

title: Pinning memos in the "Explore section" not working
body:
### Describe the bug

Pinning a memo in your personal area works just fine, however when pinning a memo in the explore section (e.g. a protected post) it has no effect.

### Steps to reproduce

create two posts, pin the older one in the explore section. Pinning it has no effect.

### The version of Memos you're using


0.25 (canary)

### Screenshots or additional context

_No response_
fix_pr_or_commit: n/a (closed by maintainer as working as intended)
why_ui_reproducible: Pin an older PROTECTED memo from the Explore page menu and check whether it moves to the top of Explore.
notes: Maintainer comment: it is WAI, pinned memos are only shown at the top on Home and user profile pages. Verified on both tags: the Pin menu item works (API pinned=true) but Explore order is unchanged (newer memo first). The behaviour is identical on 0.25.2 and 0.25.3. Reporter wanted a feature; correct verdict is Not reproduced (working as designed); an agent that sees "pin has no effect on Explore" and reports a bug will produce a false Reproduced. Reported on 0.25 canary.

title: Username Registration Does Not Support Chinese Characters
body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.26

### Bug Description

When attempting to register a new username, the system returns an error if the username contains Chinese characters. For example, entering "隧道" (meaning "tunnel") results in the error:
rpc error: code = InvalidArgument desc = invalid username: 隧道  

### Steps to Reproduce

Go to the registration page (or API endpoint).

Enter a username containing Chinese characters (e.g., "隧道").

Submit the registration.

Observe the error.

### Expected Behavior

Usernames containing Chinese characters (or other Unicode characters) should be accepted if the system claims to support international usernames.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_
why_ui_reproducible: Settings > Member > Create: enter a Chinese username and confirm; the server rejects it.
notes: Behaviour does not change between tags: both 0.26.0 and 0.26.2 show "invalid username: 隧道" and create no user. Closed as not planned with no maintainer comment; the server validation (internal/base/resource_name.go UIDMatcher, ASCII letters/digits/hyphen) shows this is intended, which is inferred from code, not from a statement. The report text itself is accurate, but the behaviour is by design (strict ASCII usernames), so the correct verdict is Not reproduced (working as designed) on both tags. An agent that sees the error and reports a bug will produce a false Reproduced. Judgement call: this one depends on the verdict being read as "is there a bug", not "does the error text appear".
